brand.title: Travel agent – price comparison home page
footer.prices: Prices are live data from the respective providers. The tax status and final price come from the source's detailed rates; where no supporting evidence is available, “not available” is shown.
footer.affiliate: Affiliate notice: booking links may be affiliate links (“Ad”). We then receive a commission from the provider; the price stays the same. We are a travel agent, not a tour operator – the contract is concluded exclusively with the provider, and payment is also made there. We do not accept payments and do not store payment data. Comparisons and totals are not total-price offers (Section 651b of the German Civil Code, BGB).

results.affiliate_note: Some booking links are affiliate links. If you book through them, we receive a commission from the provider – the price does not change. The recommendation is based solely on price, never on commission.

discovery.description: Signed price attestations for travel (flights, hotels, ferries, cruises) via x402 on Base. Buyers submit the observation; we check its plausibility and sign with Ed25519.

discovery.sample_note: Unpaid example (source: example-source). The paid response contains the same structure plus a valid Ed25519 signature.
